description:
Filed and fixed by s527b (2026-10-29), M3, while fixing §22/§35 (the same rule at one more site).  docs/ppi-upstream-bugs.md §56, registry row §56, report rows (6) in docs/ppi-bug-report.t + the branch's t/ppi_bugs_pcl.t.

perl 5.40.3:  $_ = "x"; BEGIN { 1 } /x/ and print "m\n"; { 1 } /x/ and print "b\n"; my @a = grep { 1 } /(x)/; print "@a\n";  ->  m / b / x
PPI 1.291 (and the branch before group O): Operator(/) Word(x) Operator(/) -- a division; on main PCL DROPS the statement ("Handle single node of unknown type").

Fix (branch pcl, group O: 89306003 tests, c1058d05 fix): Token::Whitespace's / arm asks Tokenizer::_after_statement_block (the test group N's - arm uses): after the } of a block that opens a statement (bare, labelled) or follows a word (BEGIN, END, map, grep, sort, a sub's name) a / starts a match; after a subscript, a dereference block, an anonymous sub, return { } or an operator's { } it still divides.

=== DONE (s527b) === fixed at the source, no PCL repair existed (the statement was dropped loudly before).
subject: PPI lexes a / after a statement block's } as a division (BEGIN { } /x/, { 1 } /x/, grep { 1 } /(x)/) -- §56; FIXED on PCL's PPI branch (group O)
